data.summary: Results-driven Technology Project Manager with 15+ years of experience across Banking and Financial Services, specialising in Payments, Core Banking, and large-scale technology transformation programs. Proven track record leading end-to-end project lifecycles — from planning, budgeting, and resourcing through delivery and production support — at BNY Mellon, Citibank, and Webster Bank. Deep expertise in ISO 20022 migration (TWIST, CAMT.086, EDI 822), Agile/Scrum delivery, cross-functional team management, and stakeholder engagement at senior levels. Adept at managing SIT, UAT, regression, and DR testing cycles, driving automation initiatives, and overseeing cloud-based data transformation projects across US, Asia, LATAM, and CEEMEA regions.

experience.role: AVP – Senior Specialist, Business Technology Liaison (Reconciliation)
responsibilities: Led end-to-end daily, weekly, and monthly Cash, Position, and Digital Asset reconciliation transformation programme across Custody, Fund Accounting, Middle Office, and AIS for fixed income, financing, and related products — ensuring completion before trading-hour deadlines across global regions.

Managed full project lifecycle including requirement gathering, test strategy definition (SIT, UAT, regression), milestone tracking, RAID logs, and action item trackers across all reconciliation workstreams.
Drove reconciliation automation and AI-enabled capabilities spanning multiple source systems (FTS, Geneva, GSP, Treasury Edge, Invest One/FIS), reducing operational risk and manual data load.

Defined Business Requirement Documents, workflows, and validation criteria for internal and external data migration to the RDZ platform via NDM/SFTP — aligning with data transformation and integration best practices.
Enabled Feed Advancement (Time Discrepancy) and Unknown Data Cleansing initiatives, accelerating early reconciliation and NAV calculation for trading teams.
Managed and mentored a team of 6 analysts across multiple transformation workstreams, fostering professional growth and operational excellence.
Acted as primary liaison between Business, Client, and Technology teams; managed escalations with custodians on break resolution, trade settlements, and SLA compliance.
Maintained project artefacts including charters, integrated timelines, and process flows in JIRA and Confluence; provided regular status updates to senior stakeholders.
Continually reassessed operational and technology risks in line with regulatory requirements and governance frameworks.

Led end-to-end data migration from Central Data Repository (CDR/Oracle) to AWS-based Webster Data Repository (WDR) using Snowflake — ensuring data quality, regulatory compliance, and integration integrity throughout.
Managed migration of SAP Business Objects reports to Tableau, delivering modern self-service BI capabilities for business users across the organisation.
Defined business requirements, led UAT testing, and developed process flows to enhance system integration efficiency; provided training on new platform SOPs.
Delivered cloud-based reporting architecture enabling data-driven decision-making — demonstrating hands-on experience with cloud technologies and data integration platforms.

experience.role: System Engineer – Project Manager, Global Billing Analytics (CIB) / Cash Operations
responsibilities: Led end-to-end ORMB onboarding, implementation, and rollout across Trade and Treasury Solutions as Subject Matter Expert for ISO 20022 Global Billing including TWIST XML/BSB, CAMT.086, EDI 822, and CSS formats across US, Canada, Asia, LATAM, and CEEMEA.

Executed comprehensive UAT, SIT, Functional, Regression, and Performance testing cycles for ORMB and enterprise billing platforms — validating billing configurations, pricing calculations, invoicing workflows, payment processing, and transaction accuracy across multiple parallel environments.
Managed project budgets, resource planning, and delivery milestones; prepared Cap Plan, MIS, KPI, and ad hoc tracker reports for senior stakeholder review during weekly and monthly business reviews.

Led multiple platform re-engineering and automation initiatives across ORMB, GCAR, ECIF, Vanguard Big Data, IGS, and CRM notification distribution — significantly reducing manual reporting effort and improving data accuracy.
Managed client onboarding for Turkey, Puerto Rico, UAE, Hong Kong, and Singapore with zero data quality issues; coordinated UAT sign-off and end-to-end validation for global billing invoices.
Supported API and integration validation for billing system interfaces; performed backend validation using Oracle SQL for billing data reconciliation and pricing accuracy checks.
Led a team of 4, championing an inclusive mentoring culture and promoting compliance, accountability, and operational excellence.
Managed Citi Mortgage Loss Mitigation Programme under FHA, VA, FHLMC, and FNMA guidelines; prepared MIS, KPI, and audit reports ensuring SLA compliance.
Trained and mentored new employees on loan modifications, HAMP, short sale programmes, and financial documentation requirements.

experience.company: Intelenet Global Services (Barclays) / Wipro BPO (Delta Airlines)
responsibilities: Resolved inbound customer queries across Online, Branch, and Funds Transfer banking; mentored new joiners on COPC guidelines. Awarded Best Advisor for 100% RBSM Quality Scores (Oct–Nov 2009).
Handled airline reservations, cancellations, and ticket reissues; trained on IATA, Galileo, and CRM platforms. Recognised as Rep of the Quarter (2005).
